title: Down on the Farm
author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
selftext: Happy New Year from Gregory and Vanessa Baker and NPC Interactives @ https://npcinteractives.com here’s a mobile game for everyone. Thanks for your support. https://zap.struckd.com/games/down-on-the-farm

replies.author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
replies.body: This is pc game I released on the same day, the game link is below Happy New Year from Gregory and Vanessa Baker and NPC Interactives https://npcinteractives.com. Check out our pc game - Made with Rosebud AI https://rosebud.ai/p/f67d0111-a753-47de-b427-ad03320a94cc. You can talk "T" to the NPC's in this game through a speech bubble. Coming in 2026, NPC's will have interactive abilities and can talk to verbally and they will look human-like NPC's.
